# Test check on a valid file.
sngl check minimal.sngl
stdout 'minimal.sngl: ok'

# Test check on an invalid file.
! sngl check bad.sngl

import . "sngl:ui"
import app "sngl:app"

component main ui {
}

app.window {
    main
}
-- bad.sngl --

import app "sngl:app"

not valid sngl

}
